items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1959-10-03
items.q: That's Chief David Hennessey. That's right, Chief Hennessey. That's right, when Rabbit made a song about that.

ctx.x: Yeah, the downfall of the line, the time they had all that shooting down there when, what you call him, got killed. What did they call him? That Italian got killed that time. The chief, when the chief got killed. That's Chief David Hennessey. That's right, Chief Hennessey. That's right, when Rabbit made a song about that. That was the downfall, yeah, who killed the chief, his downfall of the line. Yeah, he had all kinds of songs on it. We talked about that before.
We want to find August sometime, his nephew in Chicago. No, August dead.
